avis.titre: Great pick me up for your eyes!
avis.texte: The Peter Thomas Roth Instant Firmx® Collagen Infusion Tightening Eye Patches deliver an immediate pick-me-up for tired under-eyes. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The texture of the patches feels very friendly to the eyes, the calming effect for the eyes is immediate and the effectiveness can be noticed to the third used. I received these Peter Thomas Roth Instant FirmX Collagen Infusion Tightening Eye Patches free from Peter Thomas Roth complimentary in exchange for my honest review. These eye patches are unique in that they start off white then turn clear after about one to two hours after your skin has soaked up all the helpful ingredients. A lot of people these days (me included) don't really have two hours during the day to wear eye patches so I loved that the instructions said you can go to sleep with them on, leave them on overnight, and take them off in the morning. I did this several times - it was super convenient and they stayed on all night which surprised me. They are easy to apply, have no smell, and caused no eye irritation. The mornings after using them I definitely felt my eyes were more hydrated and even noticed some reduction in fine lines which was a pleasant surprise. The patches include ingredients like collagen, peptides, seaweed extract, niacinamide, caffeine, and hyaluronic acid - all of which contribute to helping tighten, reduce puffiness, hydrate, brighten, and smooth the under eye area. I can definitely see myself continuing to purchase these. I do think the way they are packaged is wasteful (in a box with individual sealed packets, with another plastic container inside holding the eye patches) and would love to see the company make the packaging more sustainable in the future.
